    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AuthenticationService
    Handles sign-in, registration, and persistent user records.
    Cinemax
    Application entry point.
    Film
    Describes a film shown by the cinema.
    MenuConsole
    Text-based menus for guests and the three registered user roles.
    PasswordUtil
    Utilities for storing passwords as salted PBKDF2 hashes.
    Prenotazione
    A customer's reservation for a screening.
    PrenotazioneRepository
    Reads and writes reservation records in the CSV file.
    PrenotazioneService
    Implements client reservation rules.
    Proiezione
    A scheduled screening of a film, including time and ticket price.

    Reads, creates, updates, and deletes projection records.
    ProiezioniService
    Implements projection search and projectionist operations.
    Ruolo
    Roles supported by CineMax.
    Utente
    A registered CineMax user and their role.
